newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico second quarter GDP rises 8.8 pct - ministry.
newsitem.headline: Mexico second quarter GDP rises 8.8 pct - ministry.

text.p: Mexico's second quarter gross domestic product rose by 8.8 percent compared to the second quarter of 1996, the Finance Ministry said on Monday.
First half GDP rose 7.0 percent against the same period a year earlier, it added.
A survey of 13 Mexico City offices of brokerages and reasearch forms found expectations of a rise of 5.42 percent in the quarter.
The Reuters survey was taken before higher-than-expected industrial production figures were released on Thursday.

The Finance Ministry noted that the second quarter contained more working days than the same period in 1996 due to Easter. Factoring out the Easter effect, GDP in the quarter grew 7.4 percent, it added.

The Finance Ministry said that strong harvests of corn, wheat, bean, chiles, limes and apples bolstered the agricultural component.
It also said that the commerce contribution to GDP was mainly due to greater volumes of foreign trade and to a lesser extent internal trade.
